summary_en: Lion Corporation executed an off-auction purchase of up to 5.401 million shares (2.0% of outstanding shares) at ¥1,851.5 per share, the closing price on November 6, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3 on November 9, 2026, with a maximum acquisition amount of ¥10 billion.
title_en: Notice of Confirmation of Share Acquisition Price through Off-Auction Transaction (ToSTNeT-3) of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Lion Corporation announced the execution details of a treasury share acquisition through off-auction trading. The company will purchase up to 5.401 million shares of its ordinary stock representing 2.0% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) at ¥1,851.5 per share on November 9, 2026, via the Tokyo Stock Exchange's ToSTNeT-3 off-auction transaction. The maximum acquisition amount is capped at ¥10 billion.

The purchase will be executed through a single order during the designated trading window on the morning of November 9 at 8:45 a.m. Japan Standard Time. The execution results will be announced upon completion of trading. The company notes that while the share quantity of 5.401 million shares is fixed, market conditions may result in partial or no execution. Following the completion of the ToSTNeT-3 purchase, Lion plans to conduct additional open market purchases up to the limits of the board-approved authorization, calculated by subtracting the shares and amount acquired through ToSTNeT-3 from the total authorized amounts.
